---
title: repr
description: Pretty-print tables for debugging with recursive serialization and Roblox type support.
---

repr is a table serialization library for debugging. Formats tables as readable strings with support for Roblox types, nested structures, and cyclic reference detection.

## Usage

```luau
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local repr = require(ReplicatedStorage.Vendor.repr)

local data = {
    name = 'Player1',
    score = 100,
    items = { 'sword', 'shield', 'potion' },
}

print(repr(data))
-- Output:
-- {
--    items = { "sword", "shield", "potion" },
--    name = "Player1",
--    score = 100
-- }
```

## API Reference

### `repr(value: any, settings?: ReprSettings): string`

Serializes a value to a formatted string.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `value` | `any` | The value to serialize |
| `settings` | `ReprSettings?` | Optional formatting settings |

### ReprSettings

```luau
type ReprSettings = {
    pretty: boolean,              -- Use multi-line formatting (default: true)
    robloxFullName: boolean,      -- Use GetFullName for instances (default: false)
    robloxProperFullName: boolean, -- Use proper full names (default: true)
    robloxClassName: boolean,     -- Show class names (default: true)
    tabs: boolean,                -- Use tabs instead of spaces (default: true)
    semicolons: boolean,          -- Use semicolons instead of commas (default: false)
    spaces: number,               -- Spaces per indent level (default: 3)
    sortKeys: boolean,            -- Sort table keys (default: true)
}
```

## Examples

### Basic Table

```luau
local data = { x = 10, y = 20 }
print(repr(data))
-- { x = 10, y = 20 }
```

### Nested Tables

```luau
local player = {
    name = 'Hero',
    stats = {
        health = 100,
        mana = 50,
    },
    inventory = {
        { name = 'Sword', damage = 10 },
        { name = 'Shield', defense = 5 },
    },
}

print(repr(player))
```

### Roblox Types

```luau
local data = {
    position = Vector3.new(10, 20, 30),
    color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 128),
    cframe = CFrame.new(0, 10, 0),
    part = workspace.Baseplate,
}

print(repr(data))
-- {
--    cframe = CFrame.new(0, 10, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1),
--    color = Color3.new(1, 0, 0.5019607843137255),
--    part = game.Workspace.Baseplate (Part),
--    position = Vector3.new(10, 20, 30)
-- }
```

### Custom Settings

```luau
-- Compact single-line output
local compact = repr(data, {
    pretty = false,
    sortKeys = false,
})

-- Spaces instead of tabs
local spaced = repr(data, {
    tabs = false,
    spaces = 2,
})

-- Include semicolons
local semicolons = repr(data, {
    semicolons = true,
})
```

### Cyclic Reference Detection

```luau
local a = { name = 'A' }
local b = { name = 'B', ref = a }
a.ref = b  -- Creates cycle

print(repr(a))
-- {
--    name = "A",
--    ref = {
--       name = "B",
--       ref = {CYCLIC}
--    }
-- }
```

## Supported Types

- **Primitives**: `string`, `number`, `boolean`, `nil`
- **Tables**: Nested tables, arrays, dictionaries
- **Roblox Types**: 
  - `Instance` (with full name and class name)
  - `Vector3`, `Vector2`, `Vector3int16`, `Vector2int16`
  - `CFrame`
  - `Color3`, `ColorSequence`, `ColorSequenceKeypoint`
  - `UDim`, `UDim2`
  - `NumberRange`, `NumberSequence`, `NumberSequenceKeypoint`
  - `BrickColor`, `Rect`, `Region3`, `Region3int16`
  - `TweenInfo`, `PhysicalProperties`, `PathWaypoint`
  - `Ray`, `Axes`, `Faces`
  - `Enum`, `EnumItem`, `Enums`
  - `DateTime`, `Random`, `RBXScriptConnection`, `RBXScriptSignal`
  - `DockWidgetPluginGuiInfo`

## When to Use

Use repr for:
- Debugging complex table structures
- Logging data for analysis
- Pretty-printing configuration data
- Serializing data for display (not for storage)

Do not use repr for:
- Data persistence (use JSON or proper serialization)
- Network transmission (not optimized for size)
